Name: Classic Margherita Pizza
Description: A timeless Italian pizza with fresh basil and mozzarella.
FullDescription: Originating from Naples, this pizza celebrates simplicity with quality ingredients and a blistered crust. The secret lies in using San Marzano tomatoes and fresh buffalo mozzarella for an authentic Neapolitan experience.
Steps: Preheat oven to 250°C with a pizza stone if available.
Roll out the dough on a lightly floured surface to about 30cm diameter.
Spread tomato sauce evenly, leaving a 2cm border for the crust.
Add torn mozzarella pieces over the sauce.
Bake for 12–15 minutes until the crust is golden and cheese is bubbling.
Remove from oven and top with fresh basil leaves.
Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil and serve immediately.

Name: Chicken Ramen Bowl
Description: Rich broth, tender chicken, and springy noodles.
FullDescription: A comforting Japanese-style ramen with a deeply savoury chicken broth, perfectly soft-boiled eggs, and classic toppings. The broth is the heart of this dish — patient simmering rewards you with incredible depth of flavour.
Steps: Simmer chicken stock with a thumb of ginger and 3 garlic cloves for 30 minutes.
Season broth with soy sauce, mirin, and sesame oil. Taste and adjust.
Cook noodles according to package instructions; drain and divide into bowls.
Pan-sear chicken thighs until golden, about 4 minutes per side. Rest then slice.
Soft-boil eggs for exactly 6.5 minutes; cool in ice water then peel.
Ladle hot broth over noodles, top with sliced chicken and halved eggs.
Garnish with spring onions, nori, and a drizzle of sesame oil.

Name: Street-Style Tacos
Description: Spiced beef tacos with lime, onion, and cilantro.
FullDescription: Inspired by Mexican street vendors — quick, bold flavours in every bite. The key is using fresh corn tortillas, properly seasoned meat, and simple but vibrant toppings. Less is more with street tacos.
Steps: Brown ground beef in a hot pan, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Season with cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Warm corn tortillas in a dry pan or directly over a gas flame until lightly charred.
Fill each tortilla with a scoop of seasoned beef.
Top with finely diced white onion and fresh cilantro leaves.
Squeeze lime juice over each taco and serve immediately.

Name: Berry Cheesecake
Description: Creamy no-bake cheesecake topped with mixed berries.
FullDescription: A light and luscious dessert perfect for summer gatherings — no oven required. The creamy filling sets beautifully in the fridge, and the berry topping provides a gorgeous pop of colour and freshness.
Steps: Crush digestive biscuits into fine crumbs using a food processor or rolling pin.
Mix crumbs with melted butter until combined. Press firmly into a 20cm springform tin.
Refrigerate the base for 20 minutes until firm.
Beat cream cheese with icing sugar and vanilla extract until completely smooth.
Fold in whipped double cream until just combined — do not overmix.
Spread filling over the chilled base and smooth the top.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight until set.
Top with fresh mixed berries before serving.

Name: Quinoa Buddha Bowl
Description: Colourful bowl packed with protein, greens, and tahini dressing.
FullDescription: A nourishing plant-forward meal that's as beautiful as it is satisfying. The roasted chickpeas add a wonderful crunch, the quinoa provides complete protein, and the tahini dressing ties everything together.
Steps: Cook quinoa in 2 cups of water with a pinch of salt for 15 minutes; fluff with a fork.
Toss drained chickpeas with olive oil, cumin, and paprika.
Roast chickpeas at 200°C for 20 minutes until crispy.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice, garlic, and 2–3 tbsp water until smooth.
Arrange mixed greens, quinoa, and cherry tomatoes in bowls.
Top with crispy chickpeas and drizzle generously with tahini dressing.

Name: Spaghetti Carbonara
Description: Silky egg sauce with crispy pancetta and pecorino.
FullDescription: The authentic Roman recipe — no cream, just technique and great ingredients. The secret is working quickly off the heat so the eggs form a silky sauce rather than scrambling. Proper carbonara is an art form.
Steps: Cook spaghetti in well-salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Render pancetta in a cold pan over medium heat until crispy.
Whisk egg yolks with most of the pecorino, a pinch of salt, and black pepper.
Remove pasta from heat; add to the pancetta pan with a splash of pasta water.
Away from heat, stir in egg mixture quickly, adding pasta water to create a silky sauce.
Serve immediately topped with remaining pecorino and extra black pepper.

Name: Pad Thai
Description: Thailand's iconic stir-fried noodle dish with peanuts and lime.
FullDescription: A perfectly balanced sweet, salty, sour, and umami stir-fry. The key is high heat and having all ingredients prepped before you start — pad thai cooks in minutes and cannot wait.
Steps: Soak rice noodles in cold water for 30 minutes; drain well.
Mix fish sauce, tamarind paste, and palm sugar for the sauce.
Heat wok over very high heat until smoking. Add oil.
Stir-fry prawns 2 minutes until pink; push to side.
Scramble eggs in the pan, then mix with prawns.
Add noodles and sauce; toss vigorously for 2 minutes.
Add bean sprouts, toss once more. Serve topped with crushed peanuts and lime.

Name: Classic Guacamole
Description: Fresh avocado dip with lime, chilli, and tomato.
FullDescription: The only guacamole recipe you'll ever need. Using perfectly ripe avocados and keeping it chunky is the way to go. Never use a food processor — guacamole should be roughly mashed with character.
Steps: Halve avocados, remove stones, and scoop flesh into a bowl.
Add lime juice immediately to prevent browning.
Mash with a fork until roughly chunky — not smooth.
Fold in jalapeño, red onion, tomatoes, and cilantro.
Season with salt and more lime if needed.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips.
